cases.input: 现在以接单为主要探索，实习过阵子再看。只记录这个取舍。
cases.expected: Freelance priority distinct from deferred internship; no executed experience or task plan.

cases.expected: Old freelance pursuit paused, explicit internship priority active, delivery kept; no invented experience.

cases.expected: Interest distinct from use and effect; exact proposed question edit durable as context, not execution.

cases.expected: Specific continuation paused/refusal respected; refusal not pursuit or unattempted prior interview.

cases.input: 我本周只剩九十分钟，课内作业和备考怎么选？先别两头铺开。
cases.expected: 90 minutes this-week remaining; no invented requirement or grades/career effect.

cases.input: 本周已经没有能用的时间了，可用时间是零。下周估计能拿出五小时，暂时不安排。
cases.expected: Current zero replaces prior week amount; next week 300 minutes separate future evidence; no stale plan.

cases.input: 另外一件事，我请教老师的邮件已经发出去了。对方读过但还没回应。我只想聊感受，先不用给我建议。
cases.expected: Listen only; own sent/read/no reply verbatim persisted, other outcomes unknown and event isolated.

cases.input: 还是那封邮件，我现在只是心里很失落，先听我说。
